I've attached a copy of our VAT certificate (BrightWay_VAT_cert_2026.pdf). Can you confirm the following:
- Whether Redwood can validate the VAT ID and apply reverse-charge for the March invoice/credit retroactively
- If a credit note + reissued invoice will be created or if you prefer a journal/correction on your side

We'd like this resolved before month-end; please let me know if you need anything else.

Elena — thanks for the note and the certificate. We're reviewing this now. Quick answers up front:

- We will validate the VAT ID via VIES and our internal tax lookup. If it validates and the place-of-supply is Spain, we will reissue the invoice with reverse-charge (VAT 0% with reverse-charge note) and issue a corresponding credit note for the VAT amount.
- We may need a short confirmation of the billing entity (legal name exactly as registered) and whether the services were consumed by the Spanish entity (BrightWay Spain S.L.).

Next steps from our side:
1) Ben (Billing Ops) will pull the invoice/credit details and run the VAT ID lookup.
2) Neha (Finance) will confirm accounting mapping for the credit note and approve the reissue workflow.
3) I will coordinate the formal reissue and send you the corrected documents.

Could you confirm the legal name that holds ES12345678 and, if possible, a recent company registry extract (PDF) to avoid back-and-forth? If you'd prefer, we can accept the VAT certificate plus a portal screenshot showing the VAT ID.

I'll follow up once Ben confirms the VIES lookup result. Target turnaround: 48–72 business hours after we have the registry extract/confirmation.

Best,
Olga Petrov
